subject: POC Kickoff & Onramp — scheduling, hands-on lab, and load test windows
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Ross <naomi.ross@finlytix.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff & Onramp — proposed times and agenda

Hi Naomi — great to connect last week. Per our call, we want to get a short POC kickoff + hands-on on the platform where we can: 1) walk through prompt sets and routing behavior, 2) run a couple of staged load tests, and 3) align success criteria and rollback conditions.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 20, 10:00–12:00 (2h, kickoff + lab)
- Wed Oct 21, 09:30–11:30 (2h)
- Thu Oct 22, 14:00–16:00 (2h)

Draft agenda attached (POC-Agenda-v1.pdf). Can you confirm which slot works for your team and who will join (security, infra, PM)? Also please confirm whether you can share a small synthetic dataset for the load tests (S3 link preferred).

Quick success criteria we propose:
- End-to-end prompt generation + routing validated against sample prompt set
- Sustained throughput of 500 reqs/min for 10 minutes without errors in the primary model path
- Latency P50 < 300ms for short prompt profile

Thanks — I’ll loop Karthik (tech lead) and Camila (solutions) after you confirm a slot.

—Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff & Onramp — proposed times and agenda

Hi Ava — thanks, all sounds good. We need to include our Head of Security (Ethan) and our infra lead; I copied Ethan here. The Wed Oct 21 slot conflicts with a board meeting, but Tue Oct 20 10:00 PT works for us. Can we shorten to 90 minutes for the kickoff and do an optional follow-up lab on Thu if we need more hands-on time?

Regarding data: we can provide a 10k-row synthetic payload and host it in our S3 test bucket (I will share the link and IAM role next). We also ask for a short pre-call design review (30 minutes) the week prior to confirm prompt framing and routing.

Naomi
Head of Product, FinLytix

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff & Onramp — confirmed Tue 10:00 PT + pre-read

Perfect — Tue Oct 20 10:00–11:30 PT saved (I’ll send the invite). We’ll keep the hands-on lab optional on Thu Oct 22 if we need deeper load windows.

Action items before the kickoff: 
- FinLytix: share S3 link + temporary IAM role for read-only access to test data (Naomi)
- Redwood: share prompt pre-read and mapping doc (we attached PreRead-Prompt-Set.xlsx)
- Tech pre-call: Ava + Karthik + Ethan for 30-min design review — propose Fri Oct 16, 11:00–11:30 PT (confirm?)

Draft attendee list (please confirm):
- Naomi Ross — Head of Product (FinLytix)
- Ethan Burke — Head of Security (FinLytix)
- Will Sanchez — Infra Lead (FinLytix)
- Ava Chen — SE, Redwood (kickoff host)
- Karthik Iyer — Inference Lead, Redwood (tech lead)
- Camila Reyes — Solutions Engineer, Redwood (lab host)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success, Redwood (CS owner)

Proposed success criteria (refined):
- Routing correctness for 3 example prompt families
- Quality checks for top-N outputs against control set
- Load smoke: 500 reqs/min sustained for 10 minutes; no >1% error rate

If you confirm the pre-call time (Fri 16, 11:00 PT) we’ll get it on calendar.

—Ava
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Naomi Ross <naomi.ross@finlytix.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-13T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff & Onramp — tech prep and load windows

Thanks for looping me in. A few technical notes ahead of the design review: 
- Pre-call checklist: sample prompt set, expected token distribution, example golden outputs (for quality checks), network egress constraints (any IP allowlist?)
- For load tests we’ll run two windows: a smoke at 200 reqs/min and a sustained run at 500 reqs/min for 10m. We need an S3 path and a small runner script; I can provide the runner if FinLytix can expose S3 read access.
- Access: if your infra team prefers, we can run load from a Dedicated pool in our staging region — this avoids hitting your production egress limits. Let us know preference.

I’ll prepare a short runbook and a Prometheus + tracing dashboard link to share during the kickoff. Also tagging a note: please confirm whether we can use sample API keys scoped to the POC (expire after 30 days).

—Karthik
Inference Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Ross <naomi.ross@finlytix.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>

All good — we’ll: 
- Share S3 link and temporary role by EOD Monday Oct 19 (s3://finlytix-testdata/poc/loadtests-v2.tar.gz).
- Confirm that the POC API key can be scoped and auto-expire — our security team prefers time-limited creds.
- Attend the Fri Oct 16 11:00–11:30 PT design review (Ethan and Will will join).

Also: Ethan asked if Redwood can provide a short security evidence packet (SOC2 scope summary + data retention notes) ahead of kickoff — we can take that offline after the design review.

Naomi

- 10:00–10:10: Introductions + objectives (Ava, Naomi)
- 10:10–10:30: Prompt mapping & expected outputs (Camila + FinLytix PM)
- 10:30–10:50: Routing topology & fallback behavior (Karthik)
- 10:50–11:10: Load plan & test windows (Karthik + Will)
- 11:10–11:25: Success criteria, rollback plan, next steps (Marissa + Naomi)

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v1.pdf, PreRead-Prompt-Set.xlsx (please review before the design review).

Next steps:
- FinLytix: share S3 link + role (Naomi) — when available, drop into the HubSpot record or reply to this thread.

Looking forward — reach out if any attendee changes.

—Ava
